messages.subject: result of permutation test
parts:
Dear Dr Karl and users,
I perform sex specific analysis for my data set. I once before performed an analysis as atrial and worked so fine. The issue is when I do permutation test it is done bt when I need to get the summary I get an error message

Operm.m <-  scanone( subset(sexsp.bw0, ind=sex==1), method="hk",  n.perm=1000, perm.Xsp=TRUE)

doing permutation in a batch mode:


when I call summary function 

object 'operm.m' not found


there is no cannot allocate vector size error message.

so what may be the cause?



best regards

Bothaina Hassan

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] result of permutation test
parts:
Maybe Operm.m vs operm.m?
Use ls() to list objects. 

karl
